attributes.name: Annihilation Spectacles
attributes.powers:
For your combat check, bury this card to use your Arcane skill + 4d6. If you defeat a non-villain monster when playing this card, banish that monster, even if it would otherwise be undefeated.

Recharge this card and discard a spell to draw a spell that has the Arcane trait from your discard pile.
